//: THIS FILE EXISTS TO STOP DENO WALKING UP TO THE REPO ROOT.
//1: Without it, Deno finds the root package.json, treats this function as
//2: part of that workspace, and writes the NODE TEST SUITE's dependencies
//3: (@supabase/supabase-js, jsdom, fake-indexeddb) into deno.lock. Those have
//4: nothing to do with an Edge Function, which imports from esm.sh - but the
//5: frozen check then fails every time package.json moves, for a reason with
//6: no connection to this function. That is what broke CI: the deps were
//7: bumped in d6c1319 and these four lockfiles were never regenerated,
//8: because nobody knew they were coupled. Regenerating would only have
//9: delayed the next false alarm to the next npm bump.
//10: An empty config is enough: its presence makes this directory its own root.
